items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: You know, and we knew them from Italy.

ctx.x: You know, and we knew them from Italy. It’s great.

He’s played up here numerous times. And I wanted to read something he said and it’s just an excerpt but he stated this. He was talking about his formative years in Milan and his fellow musicians. He said, “We felt that the way some American musicians played jazz was really special. That that was the right way. So every time we heard one of these musicians playing we heard that there was something superior.
